item.title: RBI Governor revises inflation outlook downward to 2% for FY26, reducing 0.6%
item.description: MUMBAI: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on Friday revised the inflation outlook for the current financial year, FY26, projecting CPI inflation at 2 per cent, marking a reduction of 0.6 per cent from its earlier projection. item.title: Rare goldilocks period: RBI Governor points to India’s high economic growth, low inflation phase
item.description: MUMBAI: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra on Friday characterised India’s current macroeconomic moment as a “rare goldilocks period”, that currently marks high economic growth and exceptionally low inflation.
